executive_decision.one_paragraph_thesis_en: Gold is trading at $4520, up 0.85% on the day, while the DXY has slipped to 99.16, easing dollar pressure. Technical charts show a strong bullish trend with a key resistance near $4550 and a pull‑back zone around $4480‑$4500 as entry targets. A disciplined risk plan sets stop‑loss below $4450 and scales size to New York session volatility. This setup supports a buy‑on‑pullback approach with tight capital protection.
